tspan.tspan: - 4th BDM every Month excluding National Public Holidays
- 7th BDM every Month excluding National Public Holidays
For adjustment process: Daily every Month excluding National Public Holidays
Visio modified according to the capability to allow CREDR cubes to be built as part of MAIN process and adjust CREDR progressively after BU data has been loaded.
SV: Visio Updated to add BST as downstream
FTP to auyxuap244wbcx2 by busn user
From BD5, NATIONAL PUBLIC HOLIDAY CALENDAR
1. Prepare CREDR reference data for updates, if required.
2. Update the relevant tables in the REF schema.
3. On WD4, Business to ring BART (Batch & Recovery Team) Helpdesk on 1300-722-169, request them to confirm the job nwgrcj20.
The reference update stream kicks in to update the CREDR Reference tables in Warehouse.
4. Pacific Banking stream kicks on BD4.
1. GRR team to check emails for successful completion of Monthly process.
BD5 – BD6 of the following month :
2. When adjustment data is ready, FTP the file to auyxuap244wbcx2
3. Upon successful completion of the FTP, start the adjustment process by:
Ring BART (Batch & Recovery Team) Helpdesk on 1300-722-169, request them to confirm the job nwgrcj00
4. GRR team to check for the automatic email notifying the completion of adjustment process.
The adjustment process takes approx 4:00hr to complete.
The generic email id “B2REPORTING” (Owner: Colin House, currently, access has been given to GRR Team) is not used.
5. Check results, if adjustments are needed go back to step1
6. Upon the last successful completion of adjustment process or if no adjustment is required:
Ring BART (Batch & Recovery Team) Helpdesk on 1300-722-169, request them to confirm the job nwgrcj99. This job flags
the system of the completion of CREDR processing.
A) The adjustment intraday process, scheduled to run from BD5, can handle multiple runs of adjustments in a day, starting from BD5.

B) The CREDR process is currently designed to run quarterly until Nov 07. From Dec 07 onward, it will run on a monthly basis, hence the new adjustment process cut-off date must be before the LBD of the next processing month.
